constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (command_id) REFERENCES crm_ha.reservations(reservation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (command_id) REFERENCES crm_ha.command_receipts(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (command_id) REFERENCES crm_private.unit_operations(operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (proposal_id, part_id) REFERENCES crm_ha.parts(proposal_id, part_id)
FOREIGN KEY (proposal_id, part_id) REFERENCES crm_ha.parts(proposal_id, part_id)
CHECK ((((auth_state = 'pending'::text) AND (auth_recorded_at IS NULL)) OR ((auth_state <> 'pending'::text) AND (auth_recorded_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((validity_kind = 'unknown'::text) = ((valid_from IS NULL) AND (valid_until IS NULL))))

CHECK ((((stage = 'intent'::text) AND (intent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (destination_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (content_version IS NOT NULL) AND (content_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND (result_reference IS NULL)) OR ((stage = 'attempt'::text) AND (intent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND (result_reference IS NULL)) OR ((stage = 'result'::text) AND (intent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS NOT NULL) AND (result_reference IS NOT NULL)) OR ((stage = 'uncertain'::text) AND (intent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND (result_reference IS NULL))))

CHECK ((((auth_state = 'pending'::text) AND (auth_attempt_count = 0) AND (last_auth_attempt_at IS NULL) AND (auth_revoked_at IS NULL)) OR ((auth_state = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'uncertain'::text])) AND (auth_attempt_count > 0) AND (last_auth_attempt_at IS NOT NULL) AND (auth_revoked_at IS NULL)) OR ((auth_state = 'revoked'::text) AND (auth_attempt_count > 0) AND (last_auth_attempt_at IS NOT NULL) AND (auth_revoked_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((current_epoch AND (closed_at IS NULL)) OR ((NOT current_epoch) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((NOT verified) OR (evidence_ref IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK ((((role_kind = 'primary_contact'::text) AND (party_kind = 'contact'::text)) OR ((role_kind = ANY (ARRAY['client'::text, 'payer'::text])) AND (party_kind = ANY (ARRAY['contact'::text, 'organization'::text]))) OR ((role_kind = 'participant'::text) AND (party_kind = ANY (ARRAY['contact'::text, 'group'::text])))))
CHECK (((NOT verified) OR (evidence_ref IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((NOT identity_verified) OR (evidence_ref IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((identity_kind = 'contact'::text) OR ((given_name IS NULL) AND (family_name IS NULL) AND (email IS NULL) AND (phone IS NULL))))
CHECK (((identity_kind = 'group'::text) OR ((group_type IS NULL) AND (estimated_size IS NULL) AND (confirmed_size IS NULL) AND (size_source IS NULL))))
CHECK ((((estimated_size IS NULL) AND (confirmed_size IS NULL)) OR (size_source IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((merged_into_id IS NULL) OR (archived_at IS NOT NULL)))
